title: The Episode About Banda Singh's Capture

blocks.text: As the captives near the imperial center, Farukhsiyar begins to grasp that bringing Banda alive before Delhi is itself politically dangerous.
A new section on Banda’s death opens, and when asked about the manner of his own execution, Banda answers with unwavering fatal clarity.
Farukhsiyar becomes the page’s anchor because the story now shifts from procession to imperial judgment.
